expectation_provenance_labels.static-derived; not observed reference o: derived from evidence reviewed before sanitization
expectation_provenance_labels.extracted execution (x86_64 slice, glibc: the original program's x86_64 build computed the judged values on a Linux x86_64 host, with glibc in place of the macOS system libraries: the value limits and time-grid rounding applied to the value of the case's text, the reading of the text -0, and the saved text of the resulting value; locating the notes, reading other text, opening and saving remain static-derived

stated_assumptions: Opening a set and saving it without other changes changes the notes only as the release states; a refusal raised while the notes are read stops the reading of the document (as in midi-note-storage-v1).

Decimal number text is read and written with exact, correctly rounded conversions; exact decimal ties on save round to even (as in midi-note-storage-v1). No case lies on a tie. MNS-072 depends on the reading at full precision: a value one binary64 step below the nearest value to its text would be stored as 0.
The macOS arm64 build computes these limits, roundings, readings and texts as the x86_64 build does. All cases with the extracted-execution label depend on it.
The reference's decimal reading of -0 gives negative zero, as the glibc run did. MNS-073 depends on it; the results of MNS-074 are the same for either zero.
The reference's number text on save keeps the sign of negative zero, as the glibc run did. MNS-023 and MNS-073 depend on it.

For MNS-054 to059 only: A1 ordinary Set-read validation enabled; compare the supplied conditional group data and supplied group counter. Whole-load counter repair, public catch/lifecycle, final group save and later effects are unknown and not contracted.
For MNS-076/077 only: conditional current field/list associations and ordinary reader context, with A3 integer-field binding. A1 postread rules are distinct, and A2 provides no saved result.

integer text with spaces on both sides of the digits or a + with trailing spaces; a - sign; accepted integer values above 1,000,000; MidiKey, CC, list NoteId and Id text other than plain decimal (a leading - only in CC); exception only for the exact local MNS-076 space7space input, with public outcomes still excluded
